records.context: This literal is kept in lockstep with ``setup.py::VERSION`` by ``packaging/release.py bump``.  Keeping the installed artifact's own version beside the package lets ``import spacr`` report ``spacr.__version__`` without importing :mod:`importlib.metadata` and its email, pathlib, inspect and typing stack.  The public :mod:`spacr.version` module still performs a metadata lookup when a caller explicitly asks it to inspect the installed distribution.
records.label: spacr._version#1
records.source: This literal is kept in lockstep with ``setup.py::VERSION`` by ``packaging/release.py bump``.  Keeping the installed artifact's own version beside the package lets ``import spacr`` report ``spacr.__version__`` without importing :mod:`importlib.metadata` and its email, pathlib, inspect and typing stack.  The public :mod:`spacr.version` module still performs a metadata lookup when a caller explicitly asks it to inspect the installed distribution.
records.translation: Þessum bókstafsstreng er haldið í takt við ``setup.py::VERSION`` með ``packaging/release.py bump``.  Að geyma eigin útgáfu uppsettu afurðarinnar við hlið pakkans gerir ``import spacr`` kleift að tilkynna ``spacr.__version__`` án þess að flytja inn :mod:`importlib.metadata` og stafla þess af email, pathlib, inspect og typing.  Opinbera einingin :mod:`spacr.version` flettir enn upp lýsigögnum þegar kallandi biður hana sérstaklega um að skoða uppsettu dreifinguna.

records.context: A head is a trained machine-learning classification model: it is handed a batch of extracted image regions and returns a class and a probability for each. It is a protocol rather than a base class, so an adapter around a torch module or a scikit-learn estimator can supply it. Two applications are planned -- parasites per vacuole, and what each object is -- and the PV one is three heads in practice, trained on Hoechst, the parasite stain and CellMask separately, so a plate counts from whichever stain it has.
records.label: spacr.object_classifier#5
records.source: A head is a trained classifier: it is handed a batch of crops and returns a class and a probability for each. It is a protocol rather than a base class, so an adapter around a torch module or a scikit-learn estimator can supply it. Two applications are planned -- parasites per vacuole, and what each object is -- and the PV one is three heads in practice, trained on Hoechst, the parasite stain and CellMask separately, so a plate counts from whichever stain it has.
records.translation: Haus er þjálfaður flokkari: hann fær lotu af útklipptum myndum og skilar flokki og líkum fyrir hverja. Hann er samskiptaregla frekar en grunnklasi, svo millistykki utan um torch-einingu eða scikit-learn-metil getur útvegað hann. Tvær notkanir eru fyrirhugaðar -- sníklar í hverri safabólu, og hvað hver hlutur er -- og PV-notkunin er í reynd þrír hausar, þjálfaðir á Hoechst, sníklalitun og CellMask hvert fyrir sig, svo plata telst út frá hvaða litun sem hún hefur.

records.context: The bin is a display choice, not a trained one. The head predicts a parasite count; this function only decides how that number is shown, so the rule below can change -- or be replaced by a different one per report -- without retraining anything.

records.source: The bin is a display choice, not a trained one. The head predicts a parasite count; this function only decides how that number is shown, so the rule below can change -- or be replaced by a different one per report -- without retraining anything.
records.translation: Hólfið er birtingarval, ekki þjálfað val. Hausinn spáir fyrir um fjölda sníkla; þetta fall ákveður aðeins hvernig sú tala er sýnd, svo reglan hér á eftir getur breyst -- eða önnur komið í hennar stað í hverri skýrslu -- án þess að nokkuð sé endurþjálfað.

records.context: The count goes to the nearest bin, and a tie goes to the lower bin: 12 is four from 8 and four from 16 and is reported as ``"8"``, the round of division the vacuole has completed.
records.label: spacr.object_classifier.bin_parasite_count#2
records.source: The count goes to the nearest bin, and a tie goes to the lower bin: 12 is four from 8 and four from 16 and is reported as ``"8"``, the round of division the vacuole has completed.
records.translation: Fjöldinn fer í næsta hólf, og jafntefli fer í lægra hólfið: 12 er fjórum frá 8 og fjórum frá 16 og er tilkynnt sem ``"8"``, sú skiptingarumferð sem safabólan hefur lokið.

records.source: The screen pipeline historically receives one row per ``(well, gRNA)`` and the low-level estimators receive a conventional wide design matrix. records.context: Cellpose predicts, per pixel, a flow toward the centre of the object the pixel belongs to. Timeflows adds the same idea through time: per pixel of frame ``t``, where the centre of that object is in frame ``t+1``, and whether it has a successor at all (cells die, divide, leave the microscope field of view). Linking objects between frames then reads the model instead of guessing from overlap, which is where the plain IoU stitcher fails: fast cells that move more than their own size between frames (the MuSC movies move 3-4 diameters per frame at p95).
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model#1
records.source: Cellpose predicts, per pixel, a flow toward the centre of the object the pixel belongs to. Timeflows adds the same idea through time: per pixel of frame ``t``, where the centre of that object is in frame ``t+1``, and whether it has a successor at all (cells die, divide, leave the field). Linking objects between frames then reads the model instead of guessing from overlap, which is where the plain IoU stitcher fails: fast cells that move more than their own size between frames (the MuSC movies move 3-4 diameters per frame at p95).
records.translation: Cellpose spáir, fyrir hvern díl, flæði í átt að miðju hlutarins sem díllinn tilheyrir. Timeflows bætir sömu hugmynd við í tíma: fyrir hvern díl í ramma ``t``, hvar miðja þess hlutar er í ramma ``t+1``, og hvort hann hefur yfirleitt arftaka (frumur deyja, skipta sér, fara út úr sviðinu). Tenging hluta milli ramma les þá líkanið í stað þess að giska út frá skörun, og það er þar sem einfaldi IoU-saumarinn bregst: hraðar frumur sem færast meira en eigin stærð milli ramma (MuSC-myndskeiðin færast 3-4 þvermál á ramma við p95).
